## Summary

Describe the user-visible change. The PR title must use a conventional prefix
such as `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, or `chore:`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior and pass locally.
- [ ] Generated files are current (`./tool/test_generated_code.sh`).
- [ ] Public changes have a CHANGELOG entry.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the implementation.
